fact: The STEP annual progress report for 30 June 2024 to 29 June 2025 states that the Ministry of Education's web-based digitised EMIS, which allocates unique identification numbers to students, teachers and schools, has been finalised and piloted, that 1,322 EMIS and planning experts were trained, and that in year two (July 2025 to June 2026) UNICEF is to deploy it in target schools with 4,500 computers procured for primary schools in 156 woredas, a tender due to open in August 2025.
title: System Transformation Grant Annual Progress Report Template for Projects
